gaps.criterion: A user can log in, log out and reset a forgotten password
gaps.gap: Login, refresh, logout and reset request are covered by api_definitions with negative cases. Reset confirm's happy path needs the emailed token, which an automated run cannot read (MAIL_TRANSPORT=log), so it was verified only in the end-to-end check; its negative cases run automatically. Duplicate-email 409 on register is likewise documented and verified end to end, not a testCase.
